intro: Wrestling and horse games are central to Kyrgyz sport.

chapters.title: World Nomad Games
text: Kyrgyzstan created the World Nomad Games in 2014, with horse wrestling, eagle hunting and kok-boru, a polo-like game played with a goat carcass.

chapters.title: Olympics
text: Kyrgyz wrestlers have won Olympic medals, and in 2024 Akzhol Makhmudov won the country's first Olympic gold. Kyrgyzstan played at the Asian Cup in 2019 and 2023.

items.title: Kyrgyz Premier League

items.text: Dordoi Bishkek have won many titles.
